about_the_game:
Show off your status 💎 and jumpstart the chaos 💥 with 10,000 in-game coins!

Whether you’re customizing your agent, unlocking wild new weapons 🔫, or maxing out your jetpack flair 🚀 - this Influencer Reward pack gives you the boost you need to make your mark 🎯.

Unlock your advantage. Fly fast , rule hard.✈️
